findings.title: JS-render gap: populated <head> but essentially empty body
findings.evidence: Raw HTML fetch of https://kisansuvidha.gov.in/ returned only 2 body words despite a populated <head> (title='Kisan Suvidha'). All content is likely assembled by client-side JavaScript.

suggested_action.summary: Move content for 'Kisan Suvidha' to server-side rendering (SSR) or a static prerender step — currently {wc} words appear in raw HTML, leaving crawlers with nothing to index. This page is routed to EN-13 (engagement not assessed).

findings.title: No valid JSON-LD structured data (Organization expected)
findings.evidence: Raw HTML of https://kisansuvidha.gov.in/ contains 0 JSON-LD script block(s), none of which parsed as a valid schema.org object.

suggested_action.summary: Add Organization JSON-LD to this homepage/landing page — currently 0 valid structured data blocks are present; crawlers have no machine-readable identity or facts to extract.

findings.title: Missing/empty head tags: og:image
findings.evidence: Page https://kisansuvidha.gov.in/ is missing these <head> fields (absent or empty): og:image.

suggested_action.summary: Add a meta description and OG/Twitter tags summarising 'Kisan Suvidha' — currently og:image are empty, giving AI assistants no summary text to preview or cite.

findings.title: No company-level orientation text on homepage
findings.evidence: The homepage https://kisansuvidha.gov.in/ contains no sentence that states what 'Kisan Suvidha' is as a company/platform. The page describes individual products or features but never introduces the parent entity.

suggested_action.summary: Add a short 'what is Kisan Suvidha' section (2–3 plain-text sentences) to the homepage — AI assistants use this to understand and cite the entity accurately.

findings.title: No official social profile links found for 'Kisan Suvidha'
findings.evidence: Page https://kisansuvidha.gov.in/ has no links to official social profiles (LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Facebook, GitHub, etc.) in DOM or structured data sameAs.

suggested_action.summary: Add official social profile URLs for 'Kisan Suvidha' to the footer AND to the Organization JSON-LD sameAs field — social profiles allow AI assistants to corroborate entity identity across platforms.

findings.title: No 'last updated' or publication date signal on content page
findings.evidence: Page https://kisansuvidha.gov.in/ has no article:published_time, no article:modified_time meta tag, and no visible 'last updated / as of [date]' text in the body.

suggested_action.summary: Add a visible 'last updated' or version note (e.g. 'Updated September 2026') so AI assistants have a freshness signal to cite confidently — undated content is treated as potentially stale.
